packageRules.description: TypeScript 7 is the Go rewrite and does not expose ts.sys, which is where @vue/compiler-sfc gets file access when it resolves an imported type. Every SFC that types defineProps from an imported interface then fails the build. Tried and reverted; see src/Frontend/Aegis/README.md.

Tailwind 4 is a rewrite rather than an upgrade, and its @config compatibility shim carries neither theme.container nor the sizing scale — the sign-in widget comes out roughly three times its intended size. Migrating means porting tailwind.config.js into CSS @theme and re-checking every screen, which is a task of its own. The developer console beside it is already on 4 and is not covered by this rule.
